description: Search NCATS Inxight Drugs substances by free text (drug name, synonym, code, company or condition words), optionally narrowed to a development status (US Approved Rx, US Approved OTC, US Previously Marketed, Possibly Marketed Outside US, Clinical, Other). Returns matching substances with FDA UNII and class, the total hit count, and breakdowns of the matches by development status, highest phase and top conditions. Use it to find the UNII to pass to inxight_substance or to scan, e.g., which psychedelics are in clinical development.

development_status.description: Only substances whose overall development status is this value
